“Show me around” in ⋮ is now Help. It answers “How do I…”: print the plan or one bed, get a plant list, back up your plans and restore them on another device, undo and redo, add your own plant, set the garden’s location, and mark what’s dangerous to your kids or pets. Each answer says where it is and what it does, most with a button that takes you there.
Guided start, the step-by-step introduction to a plan, is in Help too, and Help has Send feedback, the privacy policy and the terms.
Help’s answers fit your device and text size: where Redo is, and on a computer the keys for Undo and Redo (⌘Z and ⌘⇧Z on a Mac).
